FCP.Title: Phone Companion
FCP.Settings.MobileMode.Name: Companion mode on this device
FCP.Settings.MobileMode.Hint: Auto: enabled on phones and tablets. On: always use the companion interface on this device (useful for testing on desktop). Off: never.
FCP.Settings.CanvasPrompted.Name: Canvas prompt shown
FCP.Settings.MinimapTokens.Name: Tokens shown on the phone minimap
FCP.Settings.MinimapTokens.Hint: Which tokens players see on the companion minimap. Hidden tokens are never shown.
FCP.Settings.MoveRelay.Name: Validate moves on the GM client
FCP.Settings.MoveRelay.Hint: Movement requests from phones are executed by the connected GM client, which checks walls. If no GM is connected the phone moves the token directly.
FCP.Settings.ChatLimit.Name: Chat messages kept on the phone
FCP.Settings.ChatLimit.Hint: How many recent chat messages the companion renders.
FCP.CanvasPrompt.Title: Faster loading on the phone
FCP.CanvasPrompt.Content:
The companion does not need the game map. Disabling the canvas on this device makes Foundry load much faster and use far less memory.

You can re-enable it later from Settings → Core.
FCP.NoActor: No character assigned to your user. Ask the GM to give you ownership of a character.
FCP.NoToken: Your character has no token on the active scene.
FCP.NoGM: No GM connected: the move was applied directly, without wall checks.
FCP.MoveDenied: You do not control this token.
FCP.Move.Title: Move
FCP.Move.Hint: Tap an arrow to move one square, or tap a spot on the map.
FCP.Settings.QuickRolls.Name: Quick rolls (skip system dialogs)
FCP.Settings.QuickRolls.Hint: Roll immediately with the mode chosen on the phone (advantage, reaction…). Turn off to get the system's roll configuration dialog.
FCP.DH.ExperienceHint: Tap to add to the next roll (costs 1 Hope)
FCP.Settings.DigitalDice.Name: Digital dice
FCP.Settings.DigitalDice.Hint: Off (default, for playing at the table with real dice): the sheet is a reference, tapping an item shows its text. On: tapping abilities, attacks and spells rolls through Foundry, and the chat gets a quick dice bar.
FCP.MoveUnchecked: Moved without wall check (the GM is viewing another scene).
FCP.D5.DeathHint: Death saving throws, marked by hand.
FCP.Settings.MapFog.Name: Fog of war on the phone map
FCP.Settings.MapFog.Hint: The phone map shows background, walls and tokens only in the areas the party explored. The GM client records them as player tokens move: a GM must be connected with the scene open. Off, the map shows the whole background.
FCP.Settings.MapStyle.Name: Phone map style
FCP.Settings.MapStyle.Hint: Schematic: white ground with the scene grid and walls in black, readable on any map. Image: the scene background under the walls.
FCP.Doc.SaveFailed: The latest changes to “{name}” were not saved: check the connection.
FCP.Notes.Empty: No notes yet. Tap “Quick note” to start.
FCP.Notes.Unsupported: Open this kind of page on the laptop.
